run_make_global_script: run the make_global script to print a modified pyproject.toml as a global wheel config
get_global_function: call get_global to return a stripped pyproject.toml string renamed to pybind11-global
generate_global_pyproject: generate a global pyproject.toml with experimental scikit-build and install dir set to /data
remove_entry_points_and_scripts: use get_global to produce a pyproject.toml with entry-points, scripts, and optional-dependencies removed
configure_wheel_install_dir: configure the wheel install directory to /data by calling get_global on the pyproject.toml
